info.adoration: Adoration Room open Mon-Sun 7am-11pm; closed on public holidays.
info.confession: Fridays 4pm-6pm and Saturdays 10am-12pm. There is currently no Confession before Mass; you can also contact the Parish Office to make an appointment.
info.office_hours: Mon-Fri 9.30am-6.30pm; Sat-Sun 8.30am-1pm; closed on public holidays.
good_to_know: Main gate and back gate are open daily 5am-11pm, and close on public holidays after the 9am Mass.
Parish library is open Sundays 8am-1pm and 4pm-5.30pm.
Columbarium is open Mon-Fri 10am-7.30pm and Sat-Sun 8.30am-7.30pm; closed on public holidays.
Anointing of the Sick can be requested through the Parish Office; in an emergency, contact the priests of the church nearest the hospital.
